rule: Default to unchanged 75/25 candidate. Override with unchanged current Dossier only with at least 20 observed ratings, six likes, six dislikes, and observed public-review AUC <= 0.60. Repeated stratified three-fold validation uses seeds 101,211,307. Current Dossier must beat candidate and public reviews by five points in every repeat, and both title-bootstrap 95% lower bounds must exceed zero. No hidden answers or viewer IDs enter the rule.
primaryCohort: 30 previously unused MovieLens viewers; 40 fixed hidden films each. All eligible viewers, not chosen by model outcomes.
regressionCohorts: All 31 original and 47 confirmation viewers. Eight unusual-taste cases remain explicit. Viewers 82 and 484 are protected exceptions against current Dossier.
knownFailures: Exact CLI replay of five frozen worst learning declines, with guard checked after every rating. Current endpoints must still match the frozen diagnosis.

demonstrationChecks.freshMeanGain: Guard minus candidate mean AUC >= 0, 95% interval lower >= 0, and no mean first-ten loss.
demonstrationChecks.detectUsefulOverrides: At least two fresh viewers receive an override; selected fresh sessions improve by more than three points on average over candidate.
demonstrationChecks.individualSafety: No fresh or unusual-taste viewer loses more than three ranking points or one liked film per ten against the candidate.
demonstrationChecks.protectKnownExceptions: Viewers 82 and 484 lose no more than three points or one liked film per ten against current Dossier, at both 20 and 40 ratings, averaged over four orders.
demonstrationChecks.fiveFailureProtection: Each guarded 40-rating score improves over current Dossier by at least three points. Each guarded 10-to-40 decline is at most three points, and each guarded single-step decline from rating 11 onward is at most five points.

limits: Advisory experiment decisions, not automatic release gates. Selecting current Dossier cannot fix its internal mechanism. Default fallback may itself learn backwards. Thresholds are frozen before scoring; no threshold search or tuning in this experiment.
